basic_profile.bio: I'm a 38-year-old web developer from Austin, Texas. I've been a Redditor for the better part of a decade, finding solace and community in niche subreddits. I have a keen interest in strategy games, particularly GrowCastle, where I often share tips and strategies. I'm also a long-time user of dipping tobacco, and I enjoy engaging in discussions about its various brands and flavors. Outside of Reddit, I love collecting KAWS figures, which has become a passion of mine over the years. My typical online hours are late evenings, thanks to my somewhat nocturnal work schedule. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom to travel and explore new hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science from the University of Texas and have been working as a web developer for over 15 years. My knowledge in gaming comes from years of playing and strategizing, while my insights into dipping tobacco are a result of personal use and community discussions. My interest in KAWS figures is purely self-taught, driven by a passion for modern art and design.
